يستشهدا (form X)
# يَسْتَشْهِدَا (yastašhidā) /jas.taʃ.hi.daː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# يُسْتَشْهَدَا (yustašhadā) /jus.taʃ.ha.daː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
